figures.finding: The British Indian Ocean Territory has no actors' agreement, guild or fund: it is a British Overseas Territory administered from London, entry needs a permit, and its roughly 2,000 people are military personnel, officials and contractors at the Diego Garcia base.
figures.applies: British Indian Ocean Territory (IO), as of 2026-11-01; no film or television industry.

sources.said: is a British Overseas Territory. It is administered from London and is located approximately halfway between East Africa and Indonesia. Access is restricted and a permit is required in advance of travel.

Diego Garcia, the largest of the islands, makes up 44 square kilometres of that, and hosts a strategically important joint UK/US military facility. There are ordinarily around 2000 people on Diego Garcia. They are mostly a mix of UK and US military personnel, BIOTA officials and civilian contractors responsible for the maintenance and operation of the military facility.

They are mostly a mix of UK and US military personnel, BIOTA officials and civilian contractors responsible for the maintenance and operation of the military facility.' Governance: administered from the UK by a Commissioner, a BIOTA team of around 40. The site has no culture, arts, film, broadcasting or theatre section or body: no series, play, fund, incentive, director's, playwright's or actor's terms.
tried.official-register: biot.gov.io /governance/legislation/revised-ordinances/ (the Revised Ordinances index, read whole: Chapters A-H, saved files/m7/io_revord.html sha256 56c55809...); then read The Taxation Ordinance 1981 (G.2, law as at 1 Sept 2020, files/m7/io_The-Taxation-Ord-1981-G.2.pdf sha256 77880137...), The Employment Ordinance 1984 (G.5, files/m7/io_The-Employment-Ord-1984-G.5.pdf sha256 b63e789f...) and The Communications Ordinance 2018 (G.10, files/m7/io_The-Communications-Ord-2018-G.10.pdf sha256 32c70deb...) (the stage actor's minimum, the methods round of 2026-11-04). Result: No ordinance on film, broadcasting content, theatre, culture or copyright in the index. Taxation Ordinance s.3: no law 'shall have effect so as to require or permit the imposition within the Territory of any income tax, corporation tax...' (so no tax to credit a production against). Employment Ordinance: health and safety, conciliation and arbitration in trade disputes, insurance, medical care, repatriation; 'employer means a person who employs ten or more employees'; no minimum wage or pay rate. Communications Ordinance: electronic communications licences only, the word 'broadcast' does not occur. Nothing sets a playwright's, actor's or producer's term.
